rationale: Phase B3e (portfolio_positioning fleet buildout): the planner prompt is the last unfilled place of DIR-001's seven-place kind lockstep (profiles x3, components, checks enablement, planner prompt, publish-trigger VALUES). Since 432, a greenfield finance build carries content_features.<spec_key> at plan time - but build-site-planner has NO rule reading those keys, so the flag sits unread and the site only acquires its directory page and homepage section via the discovery-check round trip (missing_<x>_section/_page -> content-gap-planner), one full sweep late and after the first deploy has already shipped without them. Migration 433 (applied 2026-08-15 22:24Z after a clean COMMIT->ROLLBACK dry run) splices a Directory rule paragraph after the News listing rule (206's proven splice point for content_features-driven planning rules) plus RULES entry 18, teaching the planner: for each of the six directory keys with recommended=true, the section component on the homepage; when separate_page=true, additionally ONE dedicated page with the EXACT directoryCheckProfiles name/page_type, composed hero -> <x>-listing -> call-to-action in header+footer nav. Every mapping value is verbatim from check_directory.go:72-149, and the composition matches BOTH the three live directory pages on ai-agent-orchestration.com AND MissingDirectoryPageCheck's own suggestion text - the planner now plans exactly what the checks would otherwise demand. The six page types are stated as CONDITIONAL additions to the canonical table (valid only when the flag licenses them): an unconditioned table row would invite a directory page on any vaguely-matching site, and a page for a kind the site has not opted into ships empty by design (the publish leg fans out only to opted-in sites with a deployed component).

plan.summary: Migration 433 (applied 2026-08-15): teach build-site-planner the directory vocabulary - a Directory rule paragraph (six content_features keys -> section component on homepage; separate_page=true -> dedicated page with exact directoryCheckProfiles name/page_type, hero -> listing -> call-to-action composition) plus RULES entry 18, spliced surgically into plan_site.config.prompt_template via jsonb_set + replace() on the decoded string, with exactly-one-active-row, anchor-exactly-once and already-applied guards; surgical-inverse ROLLBACK carrying the same guards.
plan.risks: (1) The rule enumerates the six keys explicitly, so adding a SEVENTH directory kind must edit this prompt again - that is DIR-001's documented seven-place lockstep (LANDMINES entry exists), now with the planner-prompt place actually filled rather than pending. (2) The prompt grows ~2.4KB, a marginal per-plan token cost on an already 20KB prompt. (3) A planner that hallucinates a directory page WITHOUT the flag was already possible before this change; the rule forbids it twice over (conditional-additions sentence + final do-NOT sentence), and the publish leg's own opt-in gate means such a page ships an empty shell rather than wrong data - unchanged residual, stated for completeness. (4) In-flight planner orchestrations carry their own workflow snapshot and are unaffected; config is live for the next dispatch. (5) The directory page types are UNKNOWN to the Go role validator by design - verified they pass through untouched (normaliseRole default arm, CanonicalisePage default arm preserves type, name=slug, url=/<slug>.html, the exact shape of the three live pages; no section-index flattening trigger applies: no -index suffix, no declared parent, no /<slug>/index.html URL).

edits.sketch:
-- PRE-FLIGHT GUARDS (verbatim from the applied file):
DO $do$ ... BEGIN
    SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM agent_definitions
    WHERE type = 'build-site-planner' AND is_active
      AND COALESCE(is_snapshot, false) = false AND deleted_at IS NULL;
    IF n <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '433: build-site-planner does not have exactly one active row (found %) - resolve the ambiguity before editing', n;
    END IF;
    ...
    IF position('Directory rule:' in p) > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '433: already applied - the prompt carries a Directory rule';
    END IF;
    IF (length(p) - length(replace(p, 'orphans the page from all of it.', '')))
       / length('orphans the page from all of it.') <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '433: news-rule anchor is not present exactly once - the prompt has drifted, re-derive anchors from the live row';
    END IF;
    IF (length(p) - length(replace(p, 'When no Verified Facts are listed, use plain strings only.', '')))
       / length('When no Verified Facts are listed, use plain strings only.') <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '433: rule-17 anchor is not present exactly once - the prompt has drifted, re-derive anchors from the live row';
    END IF;
END $do$;
-- APPLY: surgical jsonb_set at {workflow,steps,plan_site,config,prompt_template},
-- replace() on the DECODED string (#>> extract, to_jsonb re-encode) - a deliberate
-- tightening of 206's whole-config ::text idiom (no \n two-char-escape subtlety,
-- no accidental matches outside the prompt). WHERE re-asserts both anchors via LIKE
-- and NOT LIKE 'Directory rule:' so drift is a 0-row no-op, never a mis-splice.
-- Two insertions: (1) after the News listing rule, the Directory rule paragraph -
-- for each of the six content_features keys with recommended=true, the SECTION
-- component on the homepage; when separate_page=true additionally ONE dedicated
-- page whose name and page_type are BOTH the directoryCheckProfiles value
-- (mortgage_lender_directory -> mortgage-lenders etc.), composed hero ->
-- <x>-listing -> call-to-action, in_header+in_footer true, facts: [] on directory
-- sections; the six types stated as CONDITIONAL additions to the canonical table,
-- forbidden without the flag. (2) after RULES 17, entry 18 pointing at the rule.
-- VERIFY in-txn is DO/RAISE (a SELECT cannot stop the COMMIT): Directory rule
-- exactly once, rule 18 exactly once, mapping string present, both anchors intact.

edits.sketch:
-- Surgical inverse, NOT restore-from-backup (backup row snapshots the WHOLE
-- config; restoring would clobber later unrelated edits by other sessions).
-- Same exactly-one-active-row guard as forward (the 432 round-1 lesson: a
-- rollback without the guards runs at the worst possible moment):
    IF n <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '433 ROLLBACK: build-site-planner does not have exactly one active row (found %) - resolve the ambiguity before editing', n;
    END IF;
    IF (length(p) - length(replace(p, 'Directory rule:', ''))) / length('Directory rule:') <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION '433 ROLLBACK: Directory rule not present exactly once - 433 is not applied, or the prompt was edited since; inspect before rolling back';
    END IF;
-- Inverse replace((anchor + inserted block) -> anchor) for both insertions; the
-- long literals are byte-identical to the forward file by construction, so a
-- post-433 edit inside the inserted block makes the replace find nothing and the
-- verify block REFUSE (the correct failure). Verify: both blocks gone, both
-- anchors restored to exactly once.
